赵素梅的眼眶红了。

她低下头，假装整理林薇的衣服，不让林国强看见她的眼泪。

“你别老哭。”林国强无奈地叹了口气。

“我没哭。”赵素梅吸了吸鼻子，声音闷闷的。

林国强没再说什么，抱着林薇站起来，举高高。

林薇在半空中蹬着腿，咯咯地笑，口水滴了他一脸。

“爸爸！”林薇喊了一声。

“哎！”林国强应得又脆又响，在林薇脸上亲了一口。

赵素梅坐在炕沿上，看着丈夫和女儿，摸了摸自己的肚子，眼睛不自觉弯起。

第二天，林国强没去店里。

他让赵志军先顶着。

林国强去了老宅。

他到的时候，李红霞正坐在堂屋的太师椅上，腿上盖着一条旧棉被，手里端着一碗红糖水，小口小口地喝着。

林海柱坐在旁边，手里拿着旱烟袋，吧嗒吧嗒地抽着，烟雾缭绕的。

林国伟不在，周桂芳也不在。

林国栋和徐青青更不在。

“妈。”林国强走进堂屋，在凳子上坐下。

李红霞看见他，眉头皱了一下：“你咋来了？我让你媳妇来伺候，没让你来。”

“妈，素梅怀孕了，您知道吧？”

“知道。”

李红霞的语气淡淡的，“怀个孕怎么了？我生了五个，也没见这么娇气。”

林国强没有接这个话茬，而是不紧不慢地说：“妈，您摔了，身边得有人伺候。

这事我想过了，伺候您的事，不能光素梅一个人。

大哥家有嫂子，老三家有三弟妹，三个儿媳妇轮流来，一家一天，公平合理。”

李红霞的脸色变了：“林国强，你什么意思？我让你媳妇来伺候我几天，你跟我讲轮流？”

“妈，不是讲轮流，是讲公平。”

林国强看着她的眼睛，“三个儿媳妇都是您的儿媳妇，不能厚此薄彼。

您要是觉得素梅该来，那大嫂也该来，三弟妹也该来。

要是她们都不来，那素梅也不来。”

“你这个混账东西！我怎么就生了你这个不孝的东西！”

Zhao Sumei's eyes turned red.

She lowered her head and pretended to arrange Lin Wei's clothes to prevent Lin Guoqiang from seeing her tears.

"Don't cry all the time." Lin Guoqiang sighed helplessly.

"I'm not crying." Zhao Sumei sniffed, her voice muffled.

Lin Guoqiang didn't say anything more, he stood up with Lin Wei in his arms and held her up high.

Lin Wei kicked her legs in mid-air, giggling, drool dripping all over his face.

"Dad!" Lin Wei shouted.

"Hey!" Lin Guoqiang responded loudly and kissed Lin Wei on the face.

Zhao Sumei sat on the edge of the Kang, looked at her husband and daughter, touched her belly, and her eyes curled up unconsciously.

The next day, Lin Guoqiang did not go to the store.

He asked Zhao Zhijun to bear it first.

Lin Guoqiang went to his old house.

When he arrived, Li Hongxia was sitting on the grand master's chair in the main room, with an old quilt covering her legs, holding a bowl of brown sugar water in her hand, sipping it in small sips.

Lin Haizhu sat next to him, holding a dry pipe in his hand, smoking it, and the smoke filled the air.

Lin Guowei is not here, and neither is Zhou Guifang.

Lin Guodong and Xu Qingqing are even absent.

"Mom." Lin Guoqiang walked into the main room and sat down on the stool.

Li Hongxia frowned when she saw him: "Why are you here? I asked your wife to take care of me, and I didn't ask you to come."

"Mom, Sumei is pregnant, did you know that?"

"I know."

Li Hongxia's tone was light, "What's wrong with being pregnant? I've given birth to five children, and I've never seen her so squeamish."

Lin Guoqiang did not answer the question, but said calmly: "Mom, you fell, and you need someone to take care of you.

I have thought about this. Sumei cannot be the only one to serve you.

The eldest brother's family has a sister-in-law, the third brother's family has three younger siblings, and the three daughters-in-law take turns to come, one day for each family, which is fair and reasonable."

Li Hongxia's expression changed: "Lin Guoqiang, what do you mean? I'll ask your wife to serve me for a few days, and you tell me about taking turns?"

"Mom, it's not about taking turns, it's about fairness."

Lin Guoqiang looked into her eyes and said, "The three daughters-in-law are all your daughters-in-law, we cannot favor one over the other.

If you think Sumei should come, then the elder sister-in-law should also come, and the third younger brother and sister should also come.

If they don't come, then Sumei won't come either."

"You bastard! Why did I give birth to such an unfilial creature like you!"
